Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The permit of the Vehicle should be valid in Car Nicobar. 2. The vehicle shall be exclusive use of this office and should not be used by the service provider for an y other purpose, during office hours. 3. The vehicle shall be made available on all days including Saturday, Sunday and Holidays, as and wh en required. 4. The driver deputed on duty should carry valid driving license. 5. The drivers shall be well conversant with the roads and routes of Car Nicobar. 6. The driver shall always remain with vehicle during the entire timing of duty. In case of any need the y should seek permission from the concerned officer. 7. During the period of operation, the drivers should not be changed frequently unless desired/allowed by this office. 8. The service provider shall provide vehicle of the make/model as per the terms of contract during th e entire period of contract and should not change the vehicle without prior information and approval fro m this office. 9. The service provider should ensure that the vehicle is neat and should be in good running condition s for which no extra payment would be made. 10. In case of any breakdown in the vehicle during duty hours, the service provider shall make al ternate arrangement without delay. 11. The driver shall observe all the antiquity and protocol while performing duty. 12. If the service provider fails to deployment of vehicle/driver on any day without information, penalty may be deducted as per GeM service level agreement. 13. The service provider must obey all the terms and conditions framed in the GeM service level ag reement, breaching of agreement/ contract will be dealt seriously and action will be taken as per cl ause of GeM. 14. A daily record indicating time, millage and place of visit for each vehicle shall be maintained in th e log book which should be submitted to the concerned officer of this office for scrutiny on day to day basis. 15. The driver should not carry any illegal substances (Marijuana, drugs of any kind) and alcohol etc. 16. The Driver should comply with all road safety laws when operating the vehicle. 17. The driver should be well disciplined and show gentle behavior with the officials. 18. Hiring Bill should be submitted with due attestation of log book along with copy of permit and RC book details. 19. The bidder/Service Provider must upload document/certificate complying the Buyer Added Text Based ATC clauses along with Terms and conditions of the bid. 20. The place of jurisdiction in case of any dispute may be at Senior Veterinary Officer, Zonal Office Car Nicobar. 21. An office of the service provider shall be located at Car Nicobar for contacting them in case of a ny issue or breach of contract. 22. If the successful Bidder fails to complete the supply/ provision of services within the stipulated time pe riod as specified in the Contract, liquidated damages shall be levied at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the total contract value per week or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10% (Ten percent) of the total contract value. 23. In the event of any dispute or difference arising out of or relating to this Tender/Contract, including its i nterpretation, execution, or termination, the same shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the p rovisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, as amended from time to time.
